CEM solve time: 251.1060 seconds

=== 1. model exploitation: predicted terminal cost ‖ẑ_H − z_goal‖² ===
  CEM selected macro-actions      : median     25.97   p90    104.23
  expert macro-actions            : median     82.33   p90    230.29
  -> the model believes CEM's plan beats the expert's by x3.2
  -> CEM 'beats' the expert on 88% of segments

=== 2. cost/subgoal mismatch ===
  first-waypoint error vs the true frame:
    CEM subgoal      : median     44.64
    expert           : median     27.73
  corr(terminal cost, first-waypoint error): Spearman +0.606   Pearson +0.639
    (n=16: |r| > 0.54 is significant at p=0.05; Spearman is significant.
     Positive r means lower cost goes with a better subgoal, i.e. the
     horizon-2 objective is not actively selecting bad subgoals.)
